title: go-mutesting config
description: Configuration file schema for go-mutesting (--config flag). All fields are optional; CLI flags override config values.

skip_without_test.description: Skip source files that have no corresponding _test.go file.

skip_with_build_tags.description: Skip test files that contain Go build tags.

json_output.description: Write a full mutation report to report.json after the run.

html_output.description: Write an HTML mutation report to go-mutesting-report.html after the run.

silent_mode.description: Suppress all per-mutation output including diffs; print only the final summary.

min_msi.description: Minimum overall Mutation Score Indicator (0–100). Exit code 4 if not met. 0 disables the gate. Overridden by --min-msi CLI flag when >= 0.

min_covered_msi.description: Minimum covered-code MSI (0–100). Exit code 4 if not met. 0 disables the gate. Requires --coverage. Overridden by --min-covered-msi CLI flag when >= 0.

exclude_dirs.description: Directory path prefixes to exclude from mutation. Matched as prefixes, not globs (e.g. 'vendor' excludes any path starting with 'vendor').

disable_mutators.description: Mutator names to disable. Merged with --disable CLI flags (union; both are denylists). Supports trailing-* wildcard to disable a whole category (e.g. 'arithmetic/*'). Run go-mutesting --list-mutators for all available names.

enable_mutators.description: Allowlist: if non-empty, only mutators matching these names run. Supports trailing-* wildcard (e.g. 'branch/*'). The CLI --disable flag can still exclude entries from this list.

ignore_source_lines.description: List of regular expressions. Source lines that match any pattern are excluded from mutation. Useful for suppressing mutations on generated code, nolint annotations, or boilerplate lines.
